name: HandyPal Accessibility Widget
author: rgenzon

sections.description:
Make your website easier to use. HandyPal gives visitors control over text, contrast, reading, and navigation. Customize the widget in WordPress and keep your settings in sync with your HandyPal dashboard.

Start with the Free visitor widget. Paid plans add background fixes, optional AI assistance for labels, accessibility scans, and PDF reports. Use these tools to find your next improvements, alongside manual testing and fixes.

Key Features

  • Visitor Accessibility Tools – Text, contrast, reading, and navigation preferences
  • Text-to-Speech – Browser-based text-to-speech for reading support
  • Language Translation – Language translation tools
  • Customizable Widget – Match your brand with custom colors and positioning
  • Accessibility Support – Visitor tools complement accessibility audits and manual remediation
  • Accessibility Audits on Paid Plans – Find issues to review; some require manual fixes

Accessibility Features Include

  • Adjust text size, line height, and letter spacing
  • High contrast modes (smart, high, higher, highest)
  • Reading guide and reading mask
  • Dyslexia-friendly font
  • Hide images option
  • Keyboard navigation enhancements
  • Focus indicators
  • Color blind filters (protanopia, deuteranopia, tritanopia, achromatopsia)
  • Text-to-speech narration
  • Page zoom
  • Stop animations
  • And many more…

Quick Setup

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to Settings > HandyPal
  3. Enter your account token from handypal.net
  4. The widget automatically appears on your site!

Requirements

  • A HandyPal account (free trial available at handypal.net)
  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

External Services

This plugin connects to HandyPal when you save or verify your account token. It sends the token, site URL, and site name to https://www.handypal.net/api/wordpress/validate to authenticate and register the website. When enabled, the widget loads JavaScript and CSS from https://cdn.handypal.net and requests its configuration from HandyPal. Widget usage events may be sent to HandyPal. A HandyPal account and an authorized plan are required.

Service terms: https://www.handypal.net/terms
Privacy policy: https://www.handypal.net/privacy

Privacy Policy

HandyPal collects the following data:
* Your website URL and name (for registration and widget configuration)
* Widget usage analytics (how often the widget is opened)

Visitor analytics are handled by the HandyPal service. See the Privacy Policy.

Support

  • Documentation: handypal.net/help
  • Support: handypal.net/contact
  • Dashboard: handypal.net/dashboard
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

Search for “HandyPal” under Plugins > Add New, install and activate it, then open Settings > HandyPal.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
  3. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin
  6. Go to Settings > HandyPal to configure

Configuration

  1. Log in to your HandyPal dashboard
  2. Go to Settings and copy your Account Token
  3. In WordPress, go to Settings > HandyPal
  4. Paste your Account Token and save
  5. Your website will be automatically registered and the widget will appear
sections.faq:
Do I need a HandyPal account?

Yes. The Free plan includes the visitor widget for one website, with HandyPal branding and 5,000 widget loads per month. Paid plans add background fixes, optional AI assistance, scans, and PDF reports. See current plans and trial terms at handypal.net.

Will this slow down my website?

The widget loads asynchronously from the HandyPal CDN. Performance depends on your site, network, and configuration.

Is HandyPal WCAG 2.1 compliant?

HandyPal provides visitor accessibility tools. Installing a widget does not guarantee WCAG conformance or legal compliance. Audit your content and fix accessibility issues in your site code.

Does it work with caching plugins?

The plugin includes JavaScript exclusions for WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache, and Autoptimize. Test your caching setup after installation.

Can I use this on multiple sites?

Yes! Depending on your plan, you can use HandyPal on 1-20+ websites. Each WordPress installation will automatically register as a site on your account.

What if I already have another accessibility plugin?

HandyPal will detect other accessibility plugins and display a warning. We recommend using only one accessibility widget to avoid conflicts.

How do I customize the widget appearance?

Widget customization (position, colors, icons, button text) is managed from your HandyPal dashboard. Go to your website’s Customize page at handypal.net/dashboard to adjust the appearance.

What happens if my subscription expires?

The widget will stop appearing on your site. Your settings are preserved, so if you resubscribe, the widget will work again automatically.
sections.changelog:
1.5.3

  • Clarify visitor tools, paid background fixes, optional AI assistance, and audits.
  • Update setup instructions for the published WordPress.org plugin.
  • Clarify that saved widget settings sync with the HandyPal dashboard.

1.5.2

  • Refresh clean, visible dashboards every 15 seconds without replacing unsaved edits.

1.5.1

  • Share widget visibility and page-path rules with the HandyPal dashboard.
  • Retire local visibility overrides after an explicit import/keep choice when needed.
  • Refresh shared settings when returning to either dashboard, preserving unsaved edits.
  • Save only changed appearance fields so unrelated settings from the other dashboard are preserved.

1.5.0

  • Customize widget color, position, icon, and size directly in Settings > HandyPal.
  • Control automatic accessibility fixes in grouped WordPress dashboard controls.
  • Keep appearance and fixes synchronized with your HandyPal website settings.
  • Private account tokens stay server-side; site ownership and active subscriptions are verified on every request.
  • Tested on WordPress 7.1.3 and PHP 8.3, with PHP 7.4 compatibility regression coverage.

1.4.4

  • Fixed: Replacing or clearing an account token disconnects the previous website.
  • Fixed: Validation and fallback caches are bound to the token; fallback expires after 24 hours.
  • Improved: Repeatable WordPress.org and direct-download packaging with consistent release metadata.

1.4.3

  • Fixed: Removed directory assets (banners, icons, screenshots) from plugin package
  • Fixed: Removed inline script/style tags, using wp_enqueue exclusively
  • Fixed: Renamed main plugin file to follow plugin-slug.php convention
  • Fixed: Removed discouraged load_plugin_textdomain() call
  • Fixed: Proper input sanitization for nonce verification
  • Removed: Custom auto-update filter in favor of WordPress native auto-updates

1.4.0

  • Improved: Widget assets now loaded via wp_enqueue_style and wp_enqueue_script for better compatibility
  • Improved: Proper output escaping throughout admin interface
  • Improved: WordPress.org plugin guidelines compliance
  • Fixed: Prefixed global variables in uninstall routine
  • Removed: Debug logging from production code

1.3.0

  • Improved: New 2-column layout for settings page – easier to navigate and less scrolling
  • Improved: Cleaner sidebar with connection status, updates, and quick links
  • Improved: More compact auto-update toggle design

1.2.0

  • Added: Auto-update toggle – keep your plugin automatically updated with the latest features and security fixes
  • Added: Auto-updates enabled by default for new installations

1.1.0

  • Added: Live widget preview with actual dashboard styling
  • Security: Added nonce verification for cache clear operations
  • Security: Added environment check for SSL bypass in dev mode
  • Security: Improved escaping of dynamic content

1.0.9

  • Added: Widget preview in admin settings
  • Added: Page exclusion feature – hide widget on specific pages

1.0.8

  • Added: HandyPal shield logo on plugin settings page
  • Fixed: Icon handling in update info

1.0.7

  • Added: Check for updates section in plugin settings with one-click update

1.0.6

  • Improved: Reduced update cache time and added force refresh support

1.0.5

  • Improved: Customize link now goes directly to website’s customize page

1.0.4

  • Added: Helpful message directing users to HandyPal Dashboard for widget customization

1.0.3

  • Removed: Documentation link from settings

1.0.2

  • Removed: Position setting from plugin (now syncs from HandyPal dashboard)

1.0.1

  • Fixed: Widget CSS now loads correctly
  • Added: Automatic update notifications

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Account token authentication
  • Automatic website registration
  • Caching plugin compatibility
